finding: Historical OddsPark racecard pages may contain same-meeting or target-day finish information after the event. Merely using the racecard URL is insufficient to prove result blindness.

affected_experiments.reason: The prior blind claim depended on the now-falsified assumption that historical racecard pages were PRE-only.

new_fail_closed_rule: Historical forward-style evidence may be upgraded above retrospective only when the captured source itself is proven not to expose target outcomes at collection time, or when a repository snapshot/archive demonstrably predates the target outcome. Otherwise classify as retrospective even if predictor inputs exclude result fields.
metrics_preservation: Previously computed B1a metrics may remain as descriptive retrospective evidence; no race deletion or retune is permitted.
